title: クール・アンド・ヒート

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet have an interview for a magazine feature on "Rivals." Everything is going smoothly…

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: …And that's a wrap! We've got everything we need! Great job, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Whew… Finally, we're finished.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Having to spend the whole time with you was awwwful.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-what are you looking at me like that for? If you have something to say, go ahead and say it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Your signature racewear is so frilly.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What? Why are you bringing that up now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now that I've had the chance to really look at it, I realized how crazy it is. I'm surprised you can run with all that flappin' around.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Are you making fun of me?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Not at all. It's just not my style is all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …That reminds me. There's something I've been wanting to ask you for a while.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can never decide whether your racewear looks hot to run in or cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! So you noticed!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I made sure it had everything, so it'd be awesome to the max!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Like, belts are cool, so I've got a bunch of 'em! And even though they're leather, they're light and super easy to run in!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The balance between hot and cool is what makes it so great! It shows my dual nature… You know?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's why I run so well… I couldn't stop myself if I tried… Heh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …You mean you can't stop being so dumb, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Are you saying you don't believe in the mastery of hot and cool in my signature racewear?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I guess I'll have to make ya understand!
choice_data_list: Show her how well you run!
A match might be the fastest way to settle this…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's perfect! Seeing is believing, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Watch this, Scarlet! I'm gonna show you some masterful running you'll never forget!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm really not interested.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, having my clothes power me up is totally cool! I'm like a superhero!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh man, I bet I'm gonna shave some seconds off my time today. Make sure ya time me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're not even listening to me… You really are a total dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Humoring a very pumped-up Vodka, I time her run…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… How'd I do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Amazing! You beat your best time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're kidding, right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh. You see that, Scarlet? I got my best time ever!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whooo! ♪ That felt good! I'm just gonna keep goin'!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You just willed yourself into beating your record? Dummies like you really are scary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We watch Vodka run around joyously, Daiwa Scarlet muttering under her breath with what might be a tinge of jealousy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What? A match?! Could you not involve me in this, please?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Ah, I see. And since Scarlet's wearing her signature racewear too, we can really compare ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I've got just the thing! Come with me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right. Let's start with free weights! After that, we'll face off with equipment!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …I hate this, but I guess I have to ask. Why are we in the gym?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Listen up. This is a match between the two of us to see who has really mastered their dual natures.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Me with the hot and cool style, or you with the frilly and forceful style?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's see who's managed to bring out both of their sides better!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You dummy! You really think of the stupidest things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, Vodka keeps pushing and the battle begins…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All riiight! I win again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ughhh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh. What's the matter, Scarlet? I'm wiping the floor with you today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: B-but this is…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, what do you think those two are doing in their signature racewear?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Who knows… Practicing for something, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can concentrate with all these people around!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Um, Scarlet? What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, nothing much! There's nothing to see here, everyone. Just forget you saw anything.☆

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But as for you two… you better believe I'm going to remember this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Did you see that face? So scary…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I forgot that when it comes to having dual natures, Scarlet is always number one…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Vodka won the battle, but lost the war…
